name: Mana Pools National Park, Sapi and Chewore Safari Areas
description: Mana Pools lies on the Zambezi River in northern Zimbabwe, where a floodplain turns into a spread of shimmering lakes after each rainy season. As the pools shrink through the dry months, elephants, buffalo, leopards and cheetahs gather at the remaining water, while crocodiles patrol the river below towering cliffs. Together with the Sapi and Chewore areas, it protects nearly 6,800 square kilometres of wilderness.
